infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FLIO needs camera access to take photos of your verification documents (ID, diploma, income certificate, employment certificate).
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FLIO needs photo library access to upload verification documents from your device.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: FLIO needs microphone access for voice input during profile creation.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: FLIO uses speech recognition for voice-based profile creation.
